headline: DR urged to attract better investments for sustainable tourism
summary: Investment into the Dominican Republic's tourism sector rose 6% last year, according to the report, as the industry adopts more resilient and sustainable practices. The article says considerable room remains to consolidate Caribbean tourism.
why: Tourism is a major foreign-exchange and employment earner for Caribbean economies, so investment flows into the sector matter for hotel operators, developers and the wider economy.
original_headline: Instan a RD a atraer mejores inversiones para un turismo sostenible
